# BrushFX <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Brushes](Blitz3D-Brushes)

</div>


```blitzbasic
BrushFX:Void brush:Int32, fx:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brush` | In | Int32 | required | The brush. |
| `fx` | In | Int32 | required | Sum of the flags above. |

## Description

Switches extra effects on or off with a sum of flags: 1 full-bright (no lighting), 2 vertex colors replace the brush color, 4 flat shading, 8 no fog, 16 no back-face culling, so both sides of a triangle are drawn. A value of 0 removes all effects.
